title: Backlist
description: Automatically whitelists every player inside your saved users cache. (AKA; every player that has logged on before)
body:
Automatically whitelists every player inside your saved users cache. (AKA; every player that has logged on before)

Use `/backlist` with operator level >2 to whitelist every player in your user.cache

**This mod may lag startup or affect RAM usage when kept on a server with a very high user cache, I reccomend you uninstall it after running the command**
